newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industry firms sack 3,212 from Jan 20-25.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industry firms sack 3,212 from Jan 20-25.

text.p: Private industrial firms located in Sao Paulo state laid off 3,212 employees between Jan 20 and 25, the Sao Paulo State Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
In the previous week, Sao Paulo's industries sacked 2,747 workers.
Thirteen out of the 46 sectors included in the survey sacked personnel in the period. Eight hired new people and 25 maintained their staff unchanged.
So far this year, Sao Paulo industries have laid off 9,431 workers, or 0.48 percent of the Sao Paulo's industrial workforce.
In the last 12 months, Sao Paulo firms have sacked 164,931 workers, or 7.72 percent of Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, it added.
